honesty: This suite proves that canned provider tool-use payloads, when the HOST wires execute*ToolCall / bind*GuardOutcome, produce proof-bound results with the same Change-IR (change_fp) and the same verdict across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and LangGraph. It does NOT prove that a model spontaneously calls preflight_change_set, nor that raw tools outside the returned table are inescapable.
